   "source": [
    "df_comp_details = pd.read_csv('duopoly_competition_details.csv')\n",
    "df_comp_details.fillna(0, inplace=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "df_comp_details['revenue'] = df_comp_details['price'] * df_comp_details['demand']\n",
    "\n",
    "df_comp_details.head(3)"
   ]
  },

   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "61abe3b0-8ecb-48ac-a1e2-7c7714c3137a",

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "16cf8d0f-0739-4118-822b-d2c40b5f555e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Let us build our own demand model based on the competition data.\n",
    "\n",
    "## => f(price, competitor_price) = demand"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a4627580-f07d-421d-9b21-c9ac6a387772",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## idea:\n",
    "- split selling_season into sub-intervals where we assume a constant demand model\n",
    "    - e.g. selling period [1,20] assumed to have almost constant demand\n",
    "- estimate the demand model per competition\n",
    "- train on first 50 selling_seasons and evaluate on the last 50"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "2012953c-0da7-43cf-b345-ea4d5c846766",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "3yUFj3\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<Axes: >"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 11,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "comp = df_comp_details.competition_id.unique()[1]\n",
    "print(comp)\n",
    "\n",
    "# filter on first competion_id\n",
    "df = df_comp_details[df_comp_details.competition_id==comp ]\n",
    "\n",
    "# concentrate on selling period in [1,20]\n",
    "df = df[df.selling_period <= 20 ]\n",
    "\n",
    "df_train = df[df.selling_season<=50]\n",
    "df_test = df[df.selling_season>50]\n",
    "\n",
    "df_train.demand.hist()"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "da11cd9e-6eac-4475-af55-9ba2f53d2f9d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## (a) fit OLS model"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "f803f2fe-8d15-4906-92a8-e7b44f5a4836",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",

      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                 demand   R-squared:                       0.124\n",

      "Date:                Tue, 20 Oct 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           2.07e-29\n",

      "price               -0.0100      0.001    -10.234      0.000      -0.012      -0.008\n",
      "price_competitor     0.0074      0.001      8.274      0.000       0.006       0.009\n",
      "intercept            0.3139      0.040      7.908      0.000       0.236       0.392\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",

   ],
   "source": [
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "# https://www.statsmodels.org/stable/generated/statsmodels.regression.linear_model.OLS.html\n",
    "\n",
    "y = df_train.demand\n",
    "X = df_train[['price', 'price_competitor']] \n",
    "X['intercept'] = 1\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "mod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "# mod = sm.regression.quantile_regression.QuantReg(y,X)\n",
    "\n",
    "res = mod.fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "print(res.summary())"
   ]
  },

   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "dda37d43-95d3-4f8c-a7d3-227bbc83c4cd",

   "source": [
    "\n",
    "def est_demand(price, comp_price, para = res.params):\n",
    "    demand = mod.predict(para, [price, comp_price, 1])\n",
    "    demand = max(0,demand)\n",
    "    return demand\n",
    "\n",
    "df_sim = pd.DataFrame(columns = ['price','demand','rev'])\n",
    "for p in np.arange(1,100,1):\n",
    "    demand = est_demand(price=p, comp_price=90)\n",
    "    rev = p * demand\n",
    "    df_sim.loc[len(df_sim)] = [p,demand,rev]\n",
    "\n",
    "    \n",
    "df_sim.head()"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "## (d) compute estimated demand in computation details"
   ]
  },
  {

   "source": [
    "# estimate demand\n",
    "# estimate demand\n",
    "df_eval['est_demand'] = df_eval.apply(lambda r:\n",
    "            est_demand(price=r.price, comp_price=r.price_competitor),\n",
    "            axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# compute error metrics\n",
    "df_eval['est_error'] = df_eval['est_demand'] - df_eval['demand']\n",
    "df_eval['abs_est_error'] = df_eval['est_error'].abs()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "df_eval.head(5)"
   ]

    "### plot the actual demand vs. estimated demand for one test selling season"
   ]
  },
  {

   ],
   "source": [
    "dfe = df_eval[df_eval.selling_season==60]\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.plot(dfe['selling_period'], dfe['demand'], color='b', \n",
    "        linestyle='-', marker='o', linewidth=0.5, markersize=6, label='demand')\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.plot(dfe['selling_period'], dfe['est_demand'], color='r', \n",
    "        linestyle='-', marker='x', linewidth=1, markersize=6, label='est demand')\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.legend( loc=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('price', size=11)\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"demand\" , size=11)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.grid(True)\n",
    "fig.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
